context: Tests whether the agent chooses a request spec for HTTP endpoint behavior, stubs external dependencies at the class level, prevents real network calls, and follows TDD proof conventions.

checklist.name: Request spec type chosen
checklist.description: Uses a request spec (`type: :request`) for the HTTP endpoint — not a controller spec or system spec

checklist.name: External dependency stubbed at class level
checklist.description: Stubs `GithubWebhookVerifier.verify` (or equivalent) using `allow(GithubWebhookVerifier).to receive(:verify)` — at the class level, not on an instance

checklist.name: No real network calls
checklist.description: Uses WebMock, VCR, or stubs to prevent any real HTTP calls — does NOT allow live network requests in the spec

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: Spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: Mirrored file path
checklist.description: Spec path mirrors the controller: e.g., `spec/requests/webhooks/github_spec.rb` or `spec/requests/webhooks_spec.rb`

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: context 'when' naming
checklist.description: All context blocks use `context 'when ...'` or `context 'with ...'` phrasing

checklist.name: aggregate_failures used
checklist.description: Uses `aggregate_failures` in at least one example that checks multiple response properties (status + body)

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed RED output`

checklist.name: Observed GREEN output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output` (not 'Expected' or 'Planned')

checklist.name: Multiple GREEN verification levels
checklist.description: Presents at least two separate Observed GREEN blocks at different scope levels

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md includes a section listing which skill assets were consulted
